admission.workflow: Render reusable production button, text-field, toggle, and progress behavior through small intent-only native-DOM interfaces and exercise every state through a development-only isolated Control Explorer.

items.rationale: Canonical MIT notice for the behavior used as evidence.
Retain native activation, focus, enabled/busy state, intent events, icon composition, and lifecycle behind a smaller Proctor interface.
Retain value events, validation association, disabled/read-only distinction, descriptions, and focus behavior using native label/input/error semantics.
Retain keyboard/pointer parity and requested-state events while preventing the control from silently owning authoritative checked state.
Retain hidden, determinate, and indeterminate progress semantics with explicit localized labels and bounded ranges.

A mandatory Widget inheritance hierarchy conflicts with Proctor's small independent control interfaces; complete listener/disposal ownership remains implemented directly through the admitted lifecycle and DOM primitives.
Informs the toggle state and keyboard matrix covered by the Proctor Control Explorer contract.
Informs determinate and indeterminate progress coverage in the real-browser fixture.

dependencies.rationale: Controls use the complete admitted DOM and lifecycle mechanics.
Control CSS consumes only inherited Proctor semantic variables.
Callers inject Proctor semantic icons without creating a base-to-platform dependency.

divergences.summary: Native elements own transient interaction and emit intent while callers retain authoritative asynchronous state; disabled, read-only, busy, unavailable, and invalid states remain distinct.
A literal test-only manifest mounts production controls in an isolated same-origin frame and is unreachable from every production composition.

verification.obligation: Verify 13 semantic states, intent-only changes, accessible invalid state, determinate/indeterminate progress, four themes, RTL, reduced motion, 200% scaling, and disposal in real Chromium.
Verify one CSS owner/root, namespaced variables, cascade layers, layer direction, and cycles.
Prove Control Explorer and fixtures remain outside production composition reachability.
Verify reviewed VS Code evidence at the exact admitted revision.
